name: Visteon
outlook:
What Visteon says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales, adjusted EBITDA and cash flowBased on year-to-date performance and our outlook for the fourth quarter, Visteon is raising its full-year 2026 sales guidance range to $3.80 – $3.85 billion, while lowering its full-year adjusted EBITDA range to $370 – $410 million, and its adjusted free cash flow range to $90 – $130 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 22, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
